**Comparability note:** Both figures are consolidated, cover identical 12‑month fiscal periods ending June 30, and the FY2023 amounts are drawn from the comparative column of the same FY2024 10‑K, so no fiscal-year mismatch or restatement issue affects the comparison [DOC-1]. **Result:** Gross margin improved by approximately 0.84 percentage points (69.76% − 68.92%), an increase of roughly 84 basis points.

ANSWER: Improved by approximately 0.8 percentage points (68.92% in FY2023 to 69.76% in FY2024, ~+0.84 pp)
